questions.text: I have fallen in the past year
I use or have been advised to use a cane or walker to get around safely
Sometimes I feel unsteady when I am walking
I steady myself by holding onto furniture when walking at home
I need to push with my hands to stand up from a chair
I have some trouble stepping up onto a curb
I often have to rush to the toilet
I have lost some feeling in my feet
I take medicine that sometimes makes me feel light-headed or more tired than usual
I take medicine to help me sleep or improve my mood
I often feel sad or depressed

total_code_source: LOINC 97885-8, Stay Independent total score [Stay Independent]: written by hand, since LOINC's questionnaire leaves its total item uncoded; tools/instrument-references.php checks it is active and its component is that item's text

cutoffs.meaning: may be at risk for falling: discuss with a clinician

cutoffs_source.citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Stay Independent (STEADI brochure).
cutoffs_source.stated: "Add up the number of points for each 'yes' answer. If you scored 4 points or more, you may be at risk for falling. Discuss this brochure with your doctor."
